scope: Marketplace review follow-up: live result-journal retry and strict tenant matching for manual enable reports
validation_mode: temporary private journals, controlled HTTP fixtures and browser API fixtures on the existing local Nuxt service

fixes.issue: A successful installation could remain at phase=install after a local journal write failure until restart
fixes.behavior: Keep known outcomes per attempt, expose an unconfirmed count, and retry local writes from the running worker with fixed event IDs, payloads and timestamps before delivery
fixes.safety: Retry does not request another download, run the installer or enable again, or reconcile unrelated in-flight installs

fixes.issue: An empty tenant could bypass matching and report another tenant's installation as enabled or failed
fixes.behavior: Manual enable reports require a nonempty matching tenant plus the current Marketplace source, instance and installation revision
fixes.safety: Root runtime-only enable without tenant context retains its existing behavior and does not advance another tenant's distribution record

checks.command: PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_WEBSERVER=1 PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3030 NO_PROXY=127.0.0.1,localhost,::1 no_proxy=127.0.0.1,localhost,::1 npx playwright test tests/e2e/plugins/marketplace.spec.ts --project=chromium --workers=1 --retries=0 --grep 'unconfirmed result notice'

checks.command: ESLint on RemoteMarketplace.vue, marketplaceService.ts, remote-marketplace.spec.ts and marketplace.spec.ts using a temporary config from the installed @nuxt/eslint-config createConfigForNuxt factory
checks.result: passed with no warnings; the default root config was empty because its generated .nuxt/eslint.config.mjs was absent, so the initial ignored-file run was not used as validation

regressions: A live worker retries after restoring the journal without restarting or touching a second in-flight installation
Buffered installed and enabled/failed results preserve complete event payloads and ordering; repeated result calls do not duplicate events
Download, install and enable failure results recover after local journal write failures
Unconfirmed counts do not count the same attempt twice
Empty, whitespace-only and other-tenant contexts cannot report success or failure; a matching tenant can
HTTP install-only and enable-failure paths preserve actual responses and call the installer only once when the journal is temporarily blocked
The real Root manual-enable handler without tenant context does not change the original tenant's attempt
The warning is visible within desktop and narrow-screen viewports in Chinese and English; manual refresh clears a recovered warning with no automatic polling or installation request
Existing local-upload and shared-installer regressions remain passing
limitations: While the filesystem is unwritable, the newest known result is in memory and is not durable; a process exit uses the persisted intent and actual registry to reconcile conservatively
Restart recovery does not infer tenant activation success from runtime state alone and does not reinstall
Real two-deployment Marketplace acceptance with administrator enrollment codes and user-owned plugins remains pending

operations.temporary_services: Test-scoped HTTP servers and workers exited with their test commands; Playwright reused the existing frontend on port 3030
